Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today

Alex — great speaking with you. Looping Marcus (solutions lead) and Ben (pricing) so we can get a tailored snapshot.

Summary of what we'll deliver by end of day tomorrow (Tue):
- A concise invoice-style estimate for both 'baseline' (800M tokens/mo) and 'peak' (1.4B tokens/mo).
- Unit economics: $/1M tokens across hosted API, Dedicated reserved, and a Private-VM view with quantized model assumptions.
- A small sensitivity table showing how costs change with 10/25/50% usage variance.
- Compliance artifacts pointer (SOC 2 + regional controls).

Quick clarifying Qs so we size the right model profile:
- What percentage of requests will be short-chat vs long-completion (approx)? If uncertain, default to 60% short (<=64 tokens response) and 40% long (avg 512 tokens response).
- Any hard constraints on latency (p50/p95)?

Ben and Marcus — can you take lead on the estimate? I'll review then send to Alex + procurement.

Thanks,
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today

Lauren — attached two artifacts: veridian_token_estimate.xlsx and redwood_pricing_calc_v2.csv. Notes below for the invoice snapshot.

Invoice snapshot assumptions (baseline / peak):
- Baseline: 800M tokens/mo (mix: 60% short, 40% long) -> estimated bill: $7,600/mo hosted API (includes 10% volume discount).
- Peak: 1.4B tokens/mo -> estimated bill: $12,800/mo hosted API.

Unit economics (hosted API):
- Effective unit: $/1M tokens = baseline ~$9.5k / 1000M -> $9,500 per 1B? Wait keep consistent — convert: baseline -> $9,500 per 1B tokens equals $9.5 per 1M tokens.
- To avoid confusion: Hosted API effective rate: $9.5 per 1M tokens (baseline), peak drops to roughly $9.14 per 1M tokens due to volume discounts.

Dedicated reserved sizing (monthly reserved commit):
- For 1.4B tokens mixed workload, recommend a 2x-GPU reserved pool with burst. Estimated committed fee + per-token unitized infra Ops = ~$8.2k/mo effective (after commit) -> ~ $5.86 per 1M tokens.

Private (customer-managed) rough: depends heavily on infra capex. For calc we assume 8 A100-equivalent days/month amortized -> effective marginal cost ~ $3.7 per 1M tokens (in heavy-quantized run).

Other line items included in the attached invoice snapshot:
- SLO premium (optional): +15% for 99.9% p95 latency SLA.
- Data retention / audit log export: $300/mo.
- Enterprise support: $1,200/mo (recommended for initial weeks).

Action items:
- I'll refine the XLS with a tab that maps to Veridian's usage bands (0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 / 1.4 B tokens).
- Lauren: please confirm the short/long % or ask Alex for clarification so we lock RTT & token mix assumptions.

Ben
Pricing Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today

Alex / procurement team — attaching the invoice-style estimate and the pricing calculator we used (veridian_token_estimate.xlsx; redwood_pricing_calc_v2.csv). Highlights below so leadership can review quickly: 

- Baseline (800M tokens/mo): Hosted API estimate = $7.6k/mo -> ~ $9.5 per 1M tokens.
- Peak (1.4B tokens/mo): Hosted API estimate = $12.8k/mo -> ~ $9.14 per 1M tokens.
- If Veridian prefers a Dedicated commit, projected effective rate = ~$5.9 per 1M tokens (with a monthly reserved commitment).
- Private / on-prem model shows highest upside on unit cost but requires capex and ops (est. ~$3.7 per 1M tokens in heavy-quantized config).

Compliance / procurement: Marcus included a link in the XLS to our SOC 2 summary and a short checklist for procurement. If you prefer, we can package a procurement bundle (SOC2 + interim SNOW ticket + DSAR process) for your legal team.

Suggested next steps:
1) Procurement confirms if they want the Hosted quote vs pursuing Dedicated. If Hosted, confirm billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
2) If Dedicated is of interest, we schedule a 30-min sizing call with Marcus and your infra lead to validate peak concurrency and failover needs.
3) I'll send an official sample invoice/PO-friendly PDF once you confirm which path you prefer.

Would love a quick reply confirming the short/long split or permission to use our default 60/40. If we don't hear back by Fri, I'll assume 60/40 and proceed with a final PO-ready PDF.

Thanks,
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
